title: Minimal deterministic depth bound
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty alphabet, let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega)\to\alpha$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree that computes $f$ on every input. The minimum depth of a finite decision tree computing $f$ is at most the depth of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps inputs on $n$ coordinates over $\Omega$ to $\alpha$
$T$ is a finite decision tree on all $n$ coordinates with output in $\alpha$
